comments.mergedPostDetails:
i realize many people would prefer a way to categorize their avatar list but personally i see more benefit from being able to search my entire avatar list by name, (or even maybe a way to search with tags if they choose to add that)

i know ive been going back to some of my avatar worlds to add more stuff and with the hundred extra avatars im planning to add its going to take ages to scroll back to my personal stuff, it was getting hard enough before and im shocked we havent gotten this feature yet.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Ability to search through avatar list

comments.mergedPostDetails: It would be nice to be able to make use of that unused search box in the avatar menu to search through avatars I've personally uploaded, avatars I added to favorites or even VRChat's default avatars you can pick from by default. I have over 200+ avatars and it tends to get annoying if I'm wanting to use a specific avatar, I have to scroll through the whole list of avatars I've uploaded just to find one specific avatar I uploaded in the past.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Be able to use a search box to search for a specific personal avatar

comments.mergedPostDetails: There are many of us that have well over a thousand avatars uploaded in VRChat, it would be nice to be able to search for our own models we have made in the past a lot easier than to just consistently scrolling past our lists for near hours to find our old stuff.

comments.value: Bumping this - it's a very valuable feature that would be a big help for avatar makers alone, let alone just general users.
no no, you have to go thru pain and sufferance like i do when i look thru my hundreds of avatars and raw testing avatars like every good avatar creator does LOL

I agree with this feature request.

Additionally, it would be great if we could also toggle the sort order (ascending/descending) of the search results.

Personally, I manage my avatars by adding serial numbers to their names.

If descending name sort were possible, I could display them in a custom "newest-first" order, regardless of their actual upload/update date.

This needs to be a thing, can we get more people on this? i have uploaded 200+ personal avatars and having to scroll through all my avatars just to find one is ridiculous. there's no sort, no search, nothing. it makes it hell to try to find an avatar. its not even alphabetical or even by it's upload date. This needs to be a thing.

kind of wild such a basic staple isn't a thing. I can search through shop avatars, but not my own. I don't personally use the shop and with a platform like this, it's common for users to have hundreds of uploads. And with favorites being limited without vrc+, it's really frustrating to not even be able to just search the name of what I'm looking for.

details: So, I've noticed how VRChat still has the search bar in the avatar menu. And I personally have 100+ avatars. Why not use it to searched for avatars that you have uploaded to your account rather than scroll all the way back to get 1 avatar you need!?
title: Avatar Search functionalities - Personal avatars
